name: BABYgnon
description: BABYgnon, alternatively known as Babygnon, was a gas giant–type planet that had eight moons and occupied the fifth orbital position around its sun, Domir, in the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
lead_paragraphs: BABYgnon, alternatively known as Babygnon, was a gas giant–type planet that had eight moons and occupied the fifth orbital position around its sun, Domir, in the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
